svg.title: The phone goes quiet for the call
svg.desc: During an armed session the root daemon turns off Wi-Fi, mobile data, Bluetooth, NFC, UWB and USB data, keeps the baseband on LTE and NR, and loads firewall rules that accept only loopback, IMS traffic to the P-CSCF and up to four learned media endpoints. It writes a restore journal before each change and replays it when the session ends or at boot.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A root daemon written in Rust closes every path except the voice call itself, and writes down how to undo it before it touches anything.
